newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to offer Mezobank stake by March 31-agency.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to offer Mezobank stake by March 31-agency.

text.p: State privatisation agency APV plans to invite a tender for the sale of 89 percent of Mezobank, a medium-size bank, by March 31, the Hungarian economic news agency MTI-Econews said on Wednesday.
MTI-Econews said APV's board of directors approved on Wednesday a government proposal about the privatisation of Mezobank.

The 89 percent stake would be sold to a strategic investor and APV would offer its remaining shares in Mezobank, representing five percent of the registered capital, to the employees of the bank, the news agency said.

Investors interested in Mezobank's privatisation include two Hungarian banks, Postabank Rt and Raiffeisen Unicbank Rt, a banking unit of Austria's Raiffeisen group, and German and South Korean investors, MTI-Econews said.
